verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Vestd publishes an llms.txt at its root (HTTP 200) with a product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it. Beyond that file, agent-oriented docs are thin: the markdown docs variant (help.md) returns 404, and no OpenAPI spec exists at any probed path. Missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt covers the help and feature docs in depth, markdown versions of the docs, machine-readable API/OpenAPI docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.vestd.com/llms.txt # Vestd
